title: Umbrella-sampling MD for pressure-varied critical nuclei
action: Perform umbrella-sampling MD simulations for Lennard-Jones fluid at 25% supercooling with pressures P=10 and P=50, using harmonic bias on Q6 order parameter, system size 4000 particles. Generate critical nucleus configurations for each pressure.
description: Prepare the starting critical nuclei for the pressure-varied growth simulations.

title: Pressure-varied growth MD simulations
action: For each pressure, embed the critical nucleus from step1_pressure_umbrella into a larger liquid phase (32000 particles). Equilibrate for 10 time units with umbrella bias retained on central 4000 particles, then switch off bias and run 10 independent unbiased trajectories. Collect trajectory data.
description: Run the growth/dissolution MD trajectories for pressure-varied conditions.

title: Thermodynamic integration for bcc-liquid coexistence
action: Perform thermodynamic integration simulations for the Lennard-Jones system to determine the bcc-liquid coexistence line. Compute the chemical potential of the bcc solid and the liquid phase across a range of pressures (at least covering P=10 to P=50) and find the temperatures where they are equal, thereby mapping the occurrence domain of the metastable bcc polymorph.
description: Compute the bcc-liquid coexistence line used to rationalize polymorph selection.

title: Polymorph fraction analysis for pressure variation
action: Using local bond-order analysis (e.g., via pyscal), identify fcc, hcp, and bcc particles in all growth trajectories from step2_pressure_growth. For each pressure, compute the number of each polymorph as a function of crystallite size, average over trajectories, and determine the final core composition percentages (fcc, hcp, bcc) at the end of growth. Additionally, from the thermodynamic integration results of step2b_bcc_ti, compile the bcc-liquid coexistence line as a list of (pressure, temperature) points. Output both the final polymorph composition for P=10 and P=50 and the coexistence line in pressure_composition.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the final polymorph composition for P=10 and P=50 and the bcc-liquid coexistence line.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'P10', 'P50', and 'bcc_coexistence_line'. P10 and P50 each contain 'fcc_percent', 'hcp_percent', 'bcc_percent' (float). bcc_coexistence_line is an array of objects each with 'pressure' (float) and 'T_bcc_liquid' (float).

title: Umbrella-sampling MD for temperature-varied critical nuclei
action: Perform umbrella-sampling MD simulations for Lennard-Jones fluid at fixed pressure P=5.68, for supercoolings 22% and 10% below the melting temperature. Use harmonic bias on Q6, system size 4000 particles. Generate critical nucleus configurations for each supercooling.
description: Prepare the starting critical nuclei for the temperature-varied growth simulations.

title: Temperature-varied growth MD simulations
action: For each supercooling from step4_temp_umbrella, embed the critical nucleus into a larger liquid of 32000 particles. Equilibrate with bias (10 time units), then release and run 10 independent unbiased trajectories. Record crystallite size and coordinates.
description: Run the growth MD trajectories for temperature-varied conditions.

title: HCP cross-nucleation analysis for temperature variation
action: Analyze the trajectories from step5_temp_growth using local bond-order analysis to identify hcp particles. Compute the average number of hcp particles as a function of total crystallite size for supercoolings 22% and 10%. Output a CSV with columns: crystallite_size, hcp_22pct, hcp_10pct for sizes from 1000 to 5000 (or as obtainable).
description: Scored artifact showing hcp particle counts at different supercoolings, used to verify prevention of cross-nucleation.
output_schema: CSV with columns: 'crystallite_size' (int), 'hcp_22pct' (int), 'hcp_10pct' (int). Rows for sizes 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000 (or closest available).
